description: This file defines the PHP class 'ADODB2_mysql' which extends 'ADODB_DataDict' and provides MySQL-specific implementations for data dictionary operations within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It includes methods for mapping data types, generating SQL for index creation, and managing table alterations, specifically tailored for MySQL.

classes.name: ADODB2_mysql
classes.description: A class that provides MySQL-specific functionality for the ADOdb data dictionary abstraction layer, including data type mapping and SQL generation for schema operations.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Maps a generic data type and attributes to a MySQL-specific type code.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts internal meta type codes to actual MySQL data types.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffixes for column definitions based on nullability, default values, and other attributes.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Creates or drops index-related SQL statements for MySQL.
